entries.title: Adding a Claude account on a Mac no longer stops at a login Claude Code left empty
entries.body: On a Mac, when Claude Code had signed out or its login had lapsed, adding a Claude account could refuse every time, saying Infinitary couldn't read the Claude login. It now goes on to Claude's own sign-in, and a Claude account already added in that state shows as signed out with a Sign in button.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how Claude Code's Mac Keychain item is read; it shows only when that item holds no login, which could not be set up and photographed without touching a real login.
